# AstroTrader Pro

> AstroTrader Pro is a classical financial-astrology and esoteric-astrology app and webapp. It maps 200+ financial assets to their ruling planets and shows planetary transits, an interactive natal chart, and long/short macro-cycle readings, grounded in classical sources (Ptolemy, Bailey, Volguine, Carter, Ebertin). Educational tool — not financial advice.

## What it is
- Financial astrology (astrologia finanziaria): planetary cycles and transits applied to markets, sectors and assets.
- General & esoteric astrology (astrologia, esoterismo): 12 signs, 13 planets, houses, aspects, natal chart (tema natale), lunar nodes, fixed stars.
- Free webapp + Android app, 13 languages, offline-capable.

## Key features
- Current sky: planetary wheel, dominant aspects, long/short asset bias by ruling planet, macro-cycle vs short-term transits.
- Projections: scroll time forward to see future and recurring transits.
- Personal natal chart: birth data -> radix wheel, houses, transits to natal, best-moment timing.
- News & Outlook: financial-astrology articles with real transit dates.

## Topics
astrologia, astrologia finanziaria, esoterismo, tema natale, transiti planetari, case astrologiche, aspetti, nodi lunari, stelle fisse, astrologia mundana, cicli planetari dei mercati, financial astrology, esoteric astrology, natal chart, planetary transits, zodiac trading.
